name: Heightened Fire Snake Trap (CR 9)
body:
Heightened Fire Snake Trap
CR 9

Type magic; Detect Perception DC 32; Disarm Disable Device DC 32
Trigger sight (true seeing); Reset none

DESCRIPTION

This unusual trap attacks a surprising number of creatures. The fire snake begins at the place the trap’s trigger. From there it makes a 65 foot long line that can bend as needed to affect the most creatures possible. If the trap cannot strike all the creatures within a 65 foot radius by making a straight line, it will make as few bends as possible while still affecting as many creatures as possible.

EFFECT

Spell effect (heightened fire snake, 13d6 fire damage, DC 20 Reflex save for half damage); multiple targets (fire snake can be up to 65-ft. long)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,550 gp
